initialExam.title: Indian Bank PO 2026
initialExam.description: Indian Bank Probationary Officer recruitment. Indian Bank is a major public sector bank headquartered in Chennai with a pan-India presence.
initialExam.syllabus: Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, English Language, General Awareness, Computer Knowledge.
initialExam.examPattern: Prelims: 100 questions, 100 marks, 1 hour. Mains: 200 questions, 200 marks, 3 hours.
initialExam.selectionProcess: Prelims → Mains → Interview → Document Verification → Final Selection
initialExam.careerGrowth: PO → Officer → Manager → Senior Manager → Chief Manager → AGM → DGM → GM.
initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit indianbank.in 2. Go to Careers 3. Register 4. Fill form 5. Pay fee 6. Submit

salaryRange.description: JMGS-I scale as per IBA norms

initialExam.perks: DA, HRA, Medical, LFC, NPS, Vehicle Loan, Housing Loan

ageLimitDetails.relaxation: OBC: 3 years, SC/ST: 5 years, PwD: 10 years
